review_kind: AI technical review (Codex); no human or native-speaker signoff
review_method: Codex agents reviewed all 11 local-model schema UI drafts in each locale. Technical errors and omissions were corrected as source-bound targets. Another Codex agent independently reviewed every corrected source/target pair, including load-without-apply, no restored manual memberships, portable rules/extraction/composition, omission counts and placeholders. Standard generator, normalization and translation quality gates remain unchanged.
